data.calculate_monthly_payment_60_month_loan:
```python
# Given data
price = 24999  # Price of the 2022 Tesla Model 3 Long Range
loan_term_months = 60  # Loan term in months
annual_interest_rate = 0.05  # Annual interest rate

# Monthly interest rate
monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12

# Monthly payment calculation using the formula for an amortizing loan
monthly_payment = (price * monthly_interest_rate) / (1 - (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** -loan_term_months)

print(monthly_payment)
```
